explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Tag_Processor` to scan every tag opener in the document. The `next_tag()` method with no arguments finds any tag; on each match, `remove_attribute( 'style' )` is called to remove the style attribute. Per the documentation, attribute matching is case-insensitive (since 6.2.1), so `STYLE="…"` is handled automatically. The Tag Processor is designed to minimize diffs, leaving surrounding whitespace in place when an attribute is removed — matching the expected output shown in the task. HTML comments are never matched as tags, so their contents are left untouched. Finally, `get_updated_html()` returns the transformed document.
